confidences.reason: At step 5, the agent selected the 'List of counties in Washington' Wikipedia page and intended to scrape it for county seats and 'possibly their land areas.' That page lists county data (including county land area) and names of county seats, but not the land areas of the county seats (cities/towns). The task requires land areas of the county seats themselves, so choosing this source reflects a mismatch with the requirement.

At step 5, the agent chose the 'List of counties in Washington' page, which provides county land areas, not land areas of county seats (cities/towns). This selection reflects a conflation of county land area with county seat land area and set the workflow onto the wrong data path. Earlier steps were exploratory (searching for county seats with land area) without committing to an incorrect source, so step 5 is the first clear mistake.

The log repeatedly pursues county-level sources (Wikipedia list of counties, MRSC county profiles, Census county population totals) and never switches to municipal land-area data for the county seats or to city-level 2020 population from data.census.gov. No later step corrects this focus or identifies the largest/smallest county seats by land area.
Step 5 exists in the log and its agent is 'WebServing_Expert'.
